Actually, I just realized something. Let me re-read the `asn1_check_tlen` function's overflow check once more:

```c
if (!(i & 0x81) && ((plen + ctx->hdrlen) > len)) {
```

Wait, `i & 0x81` - this checks both the error bit (0x80) and the indefinite bit (0x01). If `i & 0x01` (indefinite) is set, the check is skipped. For indefinite length, `plen` is set to `len - (p - q)` (the remaining length). So `plen` is bounded.
